strings: The bloom from the air - Fixture Video

Written for Noctiluca's corpus: a video watch page. A player with a
     poster, the channel's avatar and name, a grid of video thumbnails with
     their titles under them, and a compact comment list. Every picture is
     the fixture's own (media/make.py); the video is make_bloom.py's
     bloom.webm, cut from the Noctiluca promo (AI-generated for rs-rich, MIT).
Night dive with the glowing plankton
I saw this from the pier last night, unreal.
What camera was this shot on?
The bit at 0:04 is my favourite.
